interpretation.requestedResult: Geometric radius of first incidence on the base, in units of the beam radius.
stated: Beam radius r, hemisphere radius 2r, symmetric vertical incidence, index 3/2 and a table in contact with the base.
assumptions: A filled axial beam, rotational symmetry, unit-index exterior and geometrical optics. A luminous spot of the same extent would require the table to register incident light across the footprint.
unknowns: Table optical response and intensity distribution.
